dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL-based system for Japanese medical billing

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (診療行為入力) - rehabilitation and psychiatric treatment calculation checks for H26.4 (April 2014) revision
purpose.summary: This program performs calculation checks and validation for medical treatment acts (診療行為) in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles rehabilitation billing rules, psychiatric hospitalization period checks, early rehabilitation calculations, and various April 2014 insurance revision compliance checks. It is a subprogram called from the main receipt entry system.

notable_features: Large working-storage with many flag fields (FLG-AREA)
OCCURS tables for rehabilitation day/count tracking
23 COPY statements for shared data structures
219 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
Extensive revision history dating from 2002 to 2014
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text (appears as mojibake). This is the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software, widely used in Japanese clinics. The program ID ORCSC80201404 follows ORCA naming conventions.
